description: ADO-ASYNC, flags crossed one at a time on a six-way cross join (about 10^6 rows): Connection.Execute with adAsyncFetch, with adAsyncFetchNonBlocking, with adAsyncExecute|adExecuteNoRecords on an UPDATE, and Recordset.Open of table K with adCmdTableDirect|adAsyncExecute and with adCmdTable|adAsyncExecute. After each: State right away, after 200 ms, Errors, and a value read. Asks which flags make the call return early and which are ignored or refused.
retentionNote: Designed r-q-ado-misc probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
